Ko–Park Theorem 3.16 gives H1 rational rank e-v+1. Natural Abel–Jacobi map onto graph H1 is surjective by parking one particle outside each short (<v) fundamental cycle, hence an equivariant isomorphism; H1 trace T-F+1. Direct cubical degree-zero/one/two signed chain traces give C2=(T²-T2-L)/2, C1=TF-2P, C0=(F²+F2)/2-F. Equivariant Euler yields boxed H2 formula; H2 integral torsion-free as subgroup of free C2 with no C3. Independently reconstructed KG6 105/585/765 cubical cells and all 720 signed S6 direct Lefschetz traces; every value equals formula; identity trace 315; class values 0,0,1,1,0,0,0,3,-9,-9,315. Small Specht character orthogonality produces claimed nine nonzero multiplicities and no trivial/sign constituents. Kneser 7 identity and transposition also checked; infinite n follows formal proof, not these finite cases.
